description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Lockheed Martin is hiring an early-career Full Stack Engineer for its Rotary & Mission Systems organization. The role involves learning the C2BMC System and its technologies, developing products to meet requirements, and completing engineering assignments on schedule.
Asc Early-Career Full Stack Engineer developing products to requirements and meeting delivery commitments

Responsibilities:
• Perform assignments in technical/engineering organizations
• Learn the C2BMC System and its different technologies
• Develop products to meet requirements
• Meet deadlines and commitments

Requirements:
• The successful candidate will have experience and/or knowledge of I.T. Infrastructure/Networking, Computer Science, Scripting/Orchestration Tools/Languages (e.g., JavaScript, Python, PowerShell, Ansible, Chef, Puppet), and Virtualization Platforms (e.g., VMWare, Virtual Box, Hyper-V)
• Must be a US Citizen
• This position will require a government security clearance
• B.S. Degree in Computer Science or related degree in STEM field
• Entry-level experience, still a learner typically with an advanced degree and 0 years' experience or bachelor's degree and 0-2+ years' experience or equivalent; some use and/or application of technical principles, theories, and concepts; develops solutions to problems of limited to moderate scope and complexity

Preferred:
• Entry level engineer that is eager to learn new technologies, apply I.T. Engineering theory, and grow in their professional capacity
• Should have a 4 year college level of understanding of I.T. Infrastructure and Computer Science concepts and technologies
• Ideally some experience with scripting/programming languages such as JavaScript, Python, and PowerShell
• a cursory knowledge of orchestration tools such as Ansible, Chef, and Puppet
• A conceptual understanding of virtualization platforms such as VMWare, Virtual Box, and Hyper-V is also desired, but not required
